calculation.description: Negative acceleration of price trend: fades the excess of the latest five-session return over the average daily return implied by the prior twenty-session return. Values are computed using information available at the close of the signal date.
calculation.artifact_format: CSV with date index and one column per tradable instrument

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC was negative for the un-negated acceleration signal in every calendar year tested (2020-2026); the persisted deceleration sign therefore has positive daily IC across all years. Cross-section dates require at least 8 valid instruments and average 13.88 instruments. Small-universe uncertainty remains material.
validation.admission: Passes benchmark gates: absolute daily IC >= 0.0070 and absolute daily ICIR >= 0.0840. Correlation is provenance metadata and requires deterministic post-Miner quarantine review.
